fields.System.Title: RET-101 — Create an RMA against an order
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want to authorise a return against a shipped order, so
that the warehouse can match the parcel when it arrives.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a shipped order, when I create an RMA for specific lines and quantities, then
  • it is created with an expiry date and a reference.
  • - Given an order not yet shipped, then RMA creation is rejected.
  • - Given a return reason, then it is mandatory and comes from a controlled list.
  • - Given an RMA, then it records who authorised it and when.
  • - Given creation, then returns.rma_created is published.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, outbound |
| Tables | rma |
| Risks | Return reasons too vague to analyse ([doc 03 §8](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
